title: Refuse configuration revision overflow before mutation
description: Configure increments a persisted i64 revision with unchecked addition after mutating configuration. At i64::MAX this can overflow or wrap. Compute the next revision with checked_add before mutation and use the existing typed Unavailable refusal when exhausted.
acceptance_criteria: A persisted Memory image at i64::MAX rejects a valid Configure request as typed Unavailable before changing configuration or storing a new image; full flake check passes.
close_reason: Checked revision exhaustion before mutation; persisted i64::MAX state remains byte-for-state unchanged and full flake check passes.

title: Migrate legacy Belief Memory file on launch
description: The packaged deployment now names belief.memory, but a live state directory may still contain only legacy belief.sema. Select the four file-state cases explicitly, rename legacy-only state to the canonical Memory path, and refuse a typed conflict when both paths exist.
acceptance_criteria: Legacy-only state is renamed to belief.memory; new-only is used unchanged; both paths produce a typed conflict naming both paths without alteration; neither path selects the fresh belief.memory path; regression tests pass; full flake check passes.
close_reason: Implemented typed four-case Memory file selection with legacy-only migration and conflict refusal; full flake check passes.

title: Flow receives a typed notice for every flow running on changed belief
description: At immutable belief-nexus 39b422e, Belief has no Flow concept or peer edge and never tells Flow which running flows hold old belief. Changed reaches subscribers only. Audit: /home/li/primary/flows/b862a0/audits/belief-nexus-v1-review.md, lines 20-26, 196-199, 330-333. This is an integration contract with Mind versionOne, not a local patch. It is first-launch priority; no repair is authorized now.
design: Design is pending the Mind beliefNexus Primary in coordination with Mind versionOne Secondary. At first launch, judge the smallest typed edge by which Belief reports successful changed-belief publication and Flow maps the affected workspace identities to running flows. Keep Belief ownership, workspace identity, publication completion, and Flow identity in their own contexts. Do no repair until the Primary settles which contract owns the mapping and acknowledgement.
acceptance_criteria: An agreed typed Belief–Flow contract is present in the responsible signal/library ethos and implemented by both repositories. A detached integration proof launches at least two flows whose workspaces use different belief sets, changes one used module, completes atomic refurnish, and shows Flow receives exactly the identities of the flows now running on old belief; the unaffected flow is absent. A failed refurnish produces no old-belief success notice. Restart/reconnect behavior is defined and tested so a delivered or recoverable notice cannot silently disappear. Nix checks pass in Belief and Flow.

title: Configured peers furnish shared registered belief repositories
description: Current ruling: the login owner has privileged Register authority at the Belief CLI. A repository registered there is shared source state: any configured peer may Furnish its modules, while an unconfigured caller is refused. Caller PID and UID remain kernel-observed provenance, distinct from registration and read authority; shared access is authorized access, not a leak. Resolve authority and subscription scope remain unresolved and are not decided by this bead. Historical executed finding at immutable 39b422e: Login Register returned Registered; Peer Register and Resolve returned NotAuthorized; Peer Furnish returned NotReady and was inconclusive. Historical static finding: Furnish scanned all snapshots and subscriptions were unfiltered.
design: All implementation design remains pending the Mind beliefNexus Primary. Preserve typed configured-peer admission and kernel-derived Caller provenance while separating those facts from repository registration and read authority. A temporary Flow Register bridge is permitted for first launch only. After a future Belief readiness proof and immutable pin, coordinate its deletion with versionOne. Do not settle Resolve authority or subscription scope in this work.
acceptance_criteria: A privileged Login registers a repository through the Belief CLI. A distinct configured binary Peer then Furnishes content from that shared repository and receives the expected content and stable placement paths. An unconfigured caller is refused. Evidence shows Caller PID and UID came from kernel provenance and were not treated as repository registration or read authority. Resolve authority and subscription scope have separate explicit rulings and proofs before implementation claims them. After the future Belief readiness proof and pin, removal of the temporary Flow Register bridge is coordinated with versionOne. Nix checks pass.
notes:
Ruling provenance: current dispatch from Mind beliefNexus Primary via build/update_nmz, 2026-11-04. Current state is judgment-only: implementation design remains pending. The temporary Flow Register bridge is allowed only for first launch; its deletion follows a future Belief readiness proof and immutable pin, coordinated with versionOne. Resolve authority and subscription scope are explicitly open.
Immutable Ready probe at body f8b44e10cbf750bc87e45a50df5656028388680b, signal ccfa452bf1b807c9f180a4cae70318e66afb9a11, meta 257d34641381a3743d58df2c9437db672a92af91, default package /nix/store/3v2wkqf3wj3miw1kq66v72fv5136wlwb-belief-nexus-v1. Fresh packaged pair reached Resolved.{ [] [] } then Configure revision 24 Ready. Packaged owner-login CLI Register returned fixture main 318e97ef1e08b4bff0ab945fedecb0cc194ab8f2. Unconfigured binary caller PID 2666842/UID 1001 received typed NotAuthorized. Distinct live Flow peer PID 2666875/UID 1001 was verified through /proc, configured as flow-peer, Configure revision 25 remained Ready, and sent binary Furnish only: found Spirit:core and Knowledge:witness, missing Vision:absent, returned stable system/skills paths, and published bytes exactly matched the login-registered repository. This proves disk publication and discovery-path configuration only. It does not prove Flow launch-selected belief, continuity across restart/reconnect, witnessed harness adoption, or integrated Flow acceptance; no harness was started. Keep this bead OPEN and preserve the temporary Flow Register bridge through versionOne integrated acceptance and coordinated removal. Full self-contained recipe, helper source/lock, pins and typed raw outputs: /home/li/primary/flows/20323c/evidence/belief-nexus-nmz-ready-f8b44e1/REPORT.md and REPRODUCE.md.
close_reason: Immutable split-owner reproduction /home/li/primary/flows/20323c/evidence/belief-nexus-nmz-ready-f8b44e1/ plus versionOne final bridge-free actual Flow proof: Flow source 6cf5e88, signal 2.0 dfc1245adf3e8551e151e2499ea930d0913135aa, package /nix/store/fx97zi3zql2rm1s5xpllx1dbdfd3axdc-flow-nexus-v1; unchanged Belief /nix/store/3v2wkqf3wj3miw1kq66v72fv5136wlwb-belief-nexus-v1; Login Register e08ee85, actual peer 1001/2891679, Ready/Defined/Launched/w1:p1, nonce N20433A13109Q1488Z12897, returned paths asserted, PIDs stopped. Durable proof script and README are committed at Flow evidence tip 6f382fb. The temporary proof directory was removed by documented cleanup. Evidence grade: source-owned live report plus remote checks and independent static/documentary verification; no independent live rerun. Flow Register is removed everywhere. Broader restart, subscription, and adoption-refresh remain separate work.

title: Belief file mock proves register resolve furnish
description: Build the file-backed Belief Nexus v1 proof. Register a repository and watch its main revision; Resolve names into found and missing; Furnish Codex workspaces with a model_instructions_file bundle for Spirit and Intent and .agents/skills for every other Kind; Subscribe and push Changed only after successful automatic atomic re-furnish. Removed and restored modules re-furnish automatically. Ambiguous module sources preserve the currently furnished workspace. Ordinary and meta paths use authenticated direct typed peer tests, caller ownership, configured peer lists, coherent configuration revision, and typed failure evidence. Prove a real Codex start discovers the generated bundle and skills. Package and prove the system with Nix.
design: Implement the complete typed ordinary and meta wire contracts first, then the Nexus, translators, repository watcher, atomic workspace generation, and subscriptions. Placement follows Kind. Every configuration field is set atomically through the responsible Nexus or Translator surface and carries one coherent revision. Bootstrap is typed. Peer access is authenticated against configured identities and direct typed peer tests exercise it. A repository main change is resolved as one candidate snapshot; only an unambiguous valid candidate replaces generated output, and Changed names successful workspaces after refurnish. Use Nix-native checks and a live Codex discovery proof.
acceptance_criteria: CLI proves Register, Resolve with one found and one missing name, Furnish into a temporary Codex workspace at model_instructions_file and .agents/skills, Subscribe/Changed, and automatic atomic re-furnish after module removal and restoration. Ambiguity leaves the current furnished workspace byte-identical. Typed failures carry evidence. Authenticated direct typed peer tests prove caller ownership and peer-list enforcement. A real Codex start reads the generated instructions and discovers the skill. Typed bootstrap and coherent per-field Nexus/Translator configuration are tested. Nix builds and runs the full proof.
notes: Supersedes the earlier placement:SystemPrompt|Skill proposal: placement is derived from source-folder Kind. Spirit and Intent go to the system-prompt bundle; all other Kinds go to skills.
close_reason: Proven at 234143836c372a6ed6b8ea561b54548aa2687db8 from a clean detached worktree: nix check passed; packaged belief-pair started from typed Place; public named belief-nexus-meta Configure None reached Ready; public named belief-nexus registered committed main and furnished separate Codex and Claude workspaces with absent-frontmatter Kind defaults plus explicit opposite default override; real codex exec and claude --print each returned BUNDLE_DEFAULT_TOKEN, BUNDLE_OVERRIDE_TOKEN, and SKILL_DEFAULT_TOKEN. Typed tests prove direct configured peer Furnish, unconfigured refusal, PeerId/Login ownership, found/missing, subscriptions/watch/refurnish, ambiguity preservation, durable recovery, and atomic publication.

title: Skill publication paths form a non-overlapping set
description: Emission prevalidation rejects identical skill destinations but accepts component-wise ancestor collisions, so staging deterministically fails only after capability settings and links are created.
acceptance_criteria: Equal or ancestor-related normalized skill destinations in either order refuse with existing PermissionDenied before filesystem effects; fresh and existing workspaces remain exact, distinct siblings publish, and full flake check passes.
close_reason: One component-wise overlap validator now refuses equal or ancestor skill destinations before effects; both orders, exact workspace preservation, sibling control, and full flake check pass.

title: Configuration revisions enforce their generated lower bound
description: Valid configuration histories begin at revision zero and advance by one, but daemon startup and translator snapshot construction/restoration accept negative revisions that runtime transitions cannot generate.
acceptance_criteria: Persisted negative daemon revisions return CorruptState before store/effects. Translator snapshot construction and restoration reject -1 and MIN with existing Configuration error before construction or mutation; revision zero controls remain valid and full flake check passes.
close_reason: Daemon startup and translator snapshot boundaries reject negative configuration revisions before store, effects, construction, or restore mutation; negative, MIN, exact rollback, zero controls, and full flake check pass.

title: Duplicate skill destinations refuse before publication effects
description: Emission prevalidation accepts duplicate normalized SkillFile relative paths. Staging then fails on the second create_new only after capability links and Codex settings have been created.
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate safe skill destinations refuse with the existing publication refusal before any workspace filesystem effect; existing settings remain byte-exact, a fresh workspace gains no owned/config/capability path, distinct destinations still publish, and the full flake check passes.
close_reason: Duplicate normalized skill destinations now refuse during prevalidation before filesystem effects; fresh, existing-settings, and distinct-path regressions pass with the full flake check.

title: Subscriber allocation is bounded and transactional
description: The runtime next_subscriber i64 is incremented unchecked, and Subscribe persistence failure removes the subscriber and rolls back the event cursor but leaves next_subscriber advanced. Bound allocation and restore every changed runtime/Memory fact on recording failure.
acceptance_criteria: At next_subscriber i64::MAX Subscribe returns existing Memory(Recording) before event cursor, subscriber set, ID, or store changes. A forced subscription store failure restores event cursor, next subscriber ID, and subscriber set exactly; a retry reuses the same ID and event sequence successfully. Full flake check passes.
close_reason: Subscriber allocation now uses checked arithmetic and recording failure restores event cursor, subscriber ID, and subscriber set exactly; boundary/retry regressions and full flake check pass.

title: Persisted event cursor enforces its generated lower bound
description: FileMemory Signal restoration accepts any i64 next_event_sequence and startup performs no semantic bound check. Values below 1 were never generated by valid runtime transitions; MIN can also underflow drain/prune subtraction. Refuse such persisted images as existing BootstrapError::CorruptState before effects or stores.
acceptance_criteria: Daemon startup with persisted next_event_sequence 0 or i64::MIN returns CorruptState before any store/effect. Fresh sequence 1 and upper-bound checked reservation remain green. Full flake check passes.
close_reason: Startup now rejects persisted event cursors below 1 as CorruptState before store/effect; zero and MIN regressions plus the full flake check pass.

title: Persisted event sequence exhaustion refuses before mutation
description: MemoryImage.next_event_sequence is a persisted i64, but next_event increments it unchecked. At i64::MAX debug builds panic and release builds wrap to i64::MIN, breaking ordered repeat-identifiable event cursors. Bound reservation before any subscriber, cursor, event, or store mutation.
acceptance_criteria: At next_event_sequence i64::MAX, Subscribe returns existing Refusal.Memory(Recording) before subscriber ID, subscriber set, Memory, or store changes; internal event emission changes and stores nothing. At i64::MAX-1 one event succeeds with that sequence and persists next i64::MAX, then the next attempt refuses unchanged. Lower-bound startup validation remains a separately ruled concern. Full flake check passes.
close_reason: Event reservation now uses checked arithmetic; exhausted Subscribe returns Memory(Recording) and internal emission is dropped before mutation, with MAX-1 boundary proofs and full flake check passing.

title: Translator refuses exhausted configuration revisions before mutation
description: TranslatorConfiguration::apply computes the expected revision with unchecked i64 addition. At i64::MAX debug builds panic and release builds wrap to i64::MIN, allowing an incoherent ConfiguredState to mutate translator configuration. Use bounded arithmetic and the existing Configuration error without a wire change.
acceptance_criteria: A restored i64::MAX translator snapshot refuses an i64::MIN ConfiguredState before any field, revision, or readiness mutation. Existing initial revision zero and coherent/gap behavior remains. belief-nexus-e7c continues to own distinct next-Signal RevisionExhausted vocabulary. Full flake check passes.
close_reason: Translator revision arithmetic is bounded; MAX-to-MIN is refused with the existing Configuration error before revision, socket, or readiness mutation, and the full flake check passes. Distinct next-Signal vocabulary remains belief-nexus-e7c.

title: Snapshot responses preserve the attempted repository identity
description: Current evidence: Register, register/watch handoff, and periodic watch accept Snapshotted payloads without checking that SourceSnapshot.repository equals the Snapshot request repository (crates/daemon/src/lib.rs:1982-1987,2055-2071). A malformed response can persist an unrequested repository, panic Register at its expected lookup, or replace a different registered snapshot. Bind response identity before any Memory/core mutation.
acceptance_criteria: Initial Register mismatch returns typed NotReady without repository mutation or an extra store. Handoff and periodic-watch mismatches preserve the valid requested and unrelated repository/workspace state while following the existing unavailable-observation treatment. Matching responses still register and advance normally. Full flake check passes.
close_reason: All Snapshot acceptance sites now require the response repository to match the attempted repository; mismatches preserve Memory/core state, and initial, handoff, watch regressions plus the full flake check pass.

title: CleanupFailed validates the refused workspace
description: Current evidence: run_cleanup derives the event owner and outer CleanupFailure.workspace from the stored workspace, but on CleanupRefused it copies FileFailure into CleanupFailed without checking file_failure.workspace equals the cleanup request/maintenance workspace (crates/daemon/src/lib.rs:2235-2274). This is an integrity gap in an attempt-owned payload; no cross-owner leak has been observed. Needed repair: validate the emission response identity before it can enter the owner-routed event.
design: Treat response workspace identity as untrusted emission evidence and accept it only when it equals the attempted cleanup workspace. Define the typed mismatch outcome before implementation; do not rewrite the nested workspace.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic failing-emission test returns CleanupRefused with a different FileFailure.workspace and proves no CleanupFailed containing that payload is emitted or persisted. The selected typed mismatch/refusal is observed. A matching workspace still emits the expected owner-routed CleanupFailed.
close_reason: CleanupRefused now publishes only when workspace and Cleaning operation match the attempted cleanup; two-owner malformed-response regression and full flake check pass.

title: Subscription event history, capacity, and close behavior have one contract
description: Current evidence: Memory persists next_event_sequence but not Event payloads; events are held in the runtime Vec<Event> (crates/daemon/src/lib.rs:1587-1636,2425-2437). SubscriberCapacity gates live subscriptions (2390-2410), and an oversized encoded response produces SubscriptionClosed.QueueOverflow (daemon server.rs:311-329). The audit's 'persisted event log' label is therefore not current fact. Needed design: state whether sequence continuity, replay/history, live capacity, and terminal close behavior are required and which layer owns each.
design: Pending Mind beliefNexus Primary judgment. This bead owns subscription delivery/history semantics only; generation retention and cleanup are separate.
acceptance_criteria: The approved contract states reconnect/replay semantics, sequence durability, capacity ownership, and terminal close behavior. Executable restart, reconnect, slow-subscriber, and oversized-response proofs cover every retained fact; no proof infers payload persistence from a persisted sequence counter.

title: Place resolution honors XDG_STATE_HOME
description: Current evidence: translator 751c326 resolves Runtime from XDG_RUNTIME_DIR but resolves State from HOME/.local/state and never reads XDG_STATE_HOME (translator/src/lib.rs:85-99). The metaflow vision says placement is derived from the standard XDG variables and nothing else. Needed change: resolve the State root through the standard XDG state rule at the Place-resolution boundary, independently of Belief process/bootstrap design.
design: Use the shared translator Place resolver as the single source of the XDG rule; exact fallback behavior must follow the approved standard-XDG design rather than being invented in Belief.
acceptance_criteria: Executable Place-resolution tests set distinct HOME and XDG_STATE_HOME and prove State uses XDG_STATE_HOME. A separate fixture covers the approved unset-XDG_STATE_HOME behavior. Runtime remains derived from XDG_RUNTIME_DIR, and a runtime-only CLI path does not require HOME merely to find Runtime.
notes:
Owner repository tracking: translator:translator-bm2. This is a cross-database text link only: shared Place resolution and runtime-only CLI correction belong to translator; Belief consumes the corrected translator revision and verifies its CLI behavior.
Integration blocker witnessed during remote flake check: meta-signal-belief-nexus 19ef166502bac6ab48f25aa7b46f158f33816987 and signal-belief-nexus 579cf898b4ebd633457c936858b1166f16e88716 each pin translator 751c326f11c874b527a69ce6377ce9e196aeca37. Repinning Belief direct dependencies to translator 3a434151152fcc5c0e0c36994c52c7cb96457a65 therefore creates two nominal identity type families and 13 compile mismatches. Approved resolution: repin both wire producers first, then Belief; no scalar conversion compatibility layer.
close_reason: Belief CLIs resolve Runtime without State; unified translator/signal pins preserve one shared identity family; full remote-backed flake check passes.

title: Workspace Layout carries every publication path component once
description: Current evidence: Layout carries owned root, generation/current names, settings/instructions and harness skills destination, but publication still hardcodes the Codex link target ../.belief/current/skills, internal skills and manifest.signal names, and .staging-* formatting (crates/emission/src/lib.rs:657-714,797-809,846-868). Skill paths are formatted as {kind}-{subject}/SKILL.md and Kind folder words are separately matched in core and emission (core lib.rs:640-645,760-772; emission lib.rs:956-964). Needed design: identify which path facts belong to Layout or a single codec/type and eliminate duplicated path knowledge.
design: Pending Mind beliefNexus Primary judgment. Path/layout facts only; harness-visible Location has its own bead.
acceptance_criteria: A reviewed path inventory has one typed source for every cited component. A non-default owned root and destination fixture publishes and validates all links, manifest, staging, and skill paths. Kind-folder spelling is implemented once and consumed by snapshot and publication paths.

title: Belief control flow has no fabricated domain values
description: Current evidence: non-text system-prompt bytes are reported against fabricated ModuleName { Spirit bundle } (crates/core/src/lib.rs:625-635); an impossible empty Repository fallback remains in ambiguous resolution mapping (daemon lib.rs:133-147); automatic/recovery furnishing passes Caller {0,0} (daemon lib.rs:1668-1685,2348-2387); translator setting-name fallback maps unrelated sets to RepositoryPolling (translator lib.rs:152-164); emission revision mismatch fabricates an empty executable path (daemon lib.rs:123-130). Needed design: add the missing types/context so each branch carries the fact actually known.
design: Pending Mind beliefNexus Primary judgment. Remove each sentinel through its missing abstraction; do not replace it with a different sentinel.
acceptance_criteria: Focused tests exercise every cited branch and assert exact typed evidence/provenance. The implementation contains no Spirit/bundle module fabrication, empty Repository/ExecutablePath fallback, zero Caller, or catch-all RepositoryPolling mapping in production paths.

title: Belief identifiers and refusals carry typed evidence instead of formatted strings
description: Current evidence: InstructionsSetting.String carries model_instructions_file and Claude's unused-for-claude placeholder (meta signal.ethos:33; flake.nix:46); Invalid carries a free String and configure emits 'must be positive' (meta signal.ethos:63; daemon lib.rs:1783-1801); Diagnostic carries String (signal ethos:48); GenerationId and ContractDigest are String with sha256:/signal: formatting in core lib.rs:840-850 and translator server.rs:9-17; TranslatorError semantic variants carry String (translator lib.rs:459-464). Needed design: decide each domain value and refusal evidence type from its actual meaning, with no prose or placeholder standing in for a variant.
design: Pending Mind beliefNexus Primary judgment. This bead is a type-design pass over identifiers/refusal evidence; sentinel values and path layout literals are separate beads.
acceptance_criteria: A reviewed inventory maps every cited String carrier to a retained opaque scalar, a structured value, or a closed variant. Executable negative tests distinguish invalid numeric settings and translator failure classes without prose matching, and Claude layout needs no placeholder instruction key.

title: Furnished Location names the harness-visible destinations
description: Current evidence: FurnishedPaths is computed as <workspace>/<owned>/<current>/<instructions> and <workspace>/<owned>/<current>/skills (crates/core/src/lib.rs:595-603). The configured Layout.skills_directory is ignored in that response even though emission creates the harness-visible link at workspace.join(skills_directory) (crates/emission/src/lib.rs:657-680,797-809). The vision's Location.Skills is the harness's skills directory. Needed design: state whether Location reports capability destinations or internal generation storage, then make the name and value agree.
design: Pending Mind beliefNexus Primary judgment. Location reporting only; publication storage design is unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Codex and Claude furnish proofs configure different SkillsDirectory values and assert the returned Location is the actual harness-visible path used by each harness. No returned location names an internal generation path unless the approved type explicitly names internal storage.
close_reason: Furnished SkillsPath now reports the configured harness destination for Codex and Claude; exact returned-path process regressions and the full flake check pass.

title: Publication generation recovery and retention receive a bounded design
description: Current evidence: immutable publication generations, current-pointer CAS/recovery, successful history, KeepAll/KeepPrevious retention, durable cleanup maintenance, and MemoryAfterPublication remain (core lib.rs:307-426; daemon lib.rs:1560-1594,2170-2233,2280-2345). KeepAll is deployed (flake.nix:46). Needed design: judge the minimal publication recovery and disk-retention shape, separating safety facts required for atomic restart from optional historical generations before any deletion or extension.
design: Pending Mind beliefNexus Primary judgment. This bead owns generation identity, publication recovery, retained history, and cleanup scheduling policy. Cleanup refusal integrity and subscription delivery history have separate bugs/tasks.
acceptance_criteria: The approved design names which generation, publication, recovery, history, and cleanup-maintenance facts persist and why. Crash/restart and bounded-disk executable proofs cover every retained mechanism. KeepAll/KeepPrevious behavior is either proven as selected policy or removed in the same approved change.

title: Translator returns typed Outcome for text calls
description: Current evidence: translator failures are written as raw error text (crates/translator/src/server.rs:113-117); TranslatorError is a Rust enum whose semantic variants mostly carry String (translator lib.rs:459-464); the ordinary and meta text paths return encoded successful responses directly (translator lib.rs:339-417). The Nexus vision names Outcome.[ Answered Unreadable.Error NexusDown ], which is absent. Needed design: place the typed call outcome at the text boundary without conflating internal diagnostics with caller-visible outcomes.
design: This bead owns the typed text-call outcome at the service boundary only. Keep internal diagnostics separate. Pending concerns remain separately named: framing/write loss, uncertain post-forward transport, and stream completion. No caller wrapper or internal diagnostic redesign is part of this bead. Design-only; no implementation or build is authorized.
acceptance_criteria: Executable SERVICE-boundary tests witness: Answered only after one domain reply is successfully written; malformed request produces typed Unreadable.Error; unreachable Nexus before forwarding produces typed NexusDown. Successful domain response datoms remain preserved. Framing/write loss, uncertain post-forward transport, and stream completion remain separately named design work and are not coerced into these three variants or treated as silently successful.
notes: Old acceptance preserved as machine provenance: Executable text-boundary tests witness Answered, malformed-input Unreadable, and unreachable-Nexus NexusDown as typed values; no failure case asserted by matching raw prose. Revised under current Core ruling relayed by Primary 671356; this is machine coordination, not living vision.

title: Belief external calls use the typed command-line abstraction
description: Current evidence: FileEmission invokes Git with std::process::Command and literal -C plus literal argument arrays (crates/emission/src/lib.rs:380-450). The Nexus vision gives command lines a typed Command/Arguable boundary held by the translator. Needed design: choose the next command abstraction and ownership step before replacing these calls.
design: Pending Mind beliefNexus Primary judgment. External-call command typing only; repository polling frequency is separate.
acceptance_criteria: The approved command value carries executable and every argument used by Snapshot. An executor-facing proof compares the exact typed argv for revision, tree listing, and content reads; FileEmission no longer assembles Git words from Rust literals outside the chosen codec/translator boundary.

title: Meta configuration surface and MetaPeers have one witnessed purpose per setting
description: Current evidence: the meta contract has 18 SettingName variants and bootstrap/restore transport types (meta signal.ethos:10-13,42-82), while the vision names the placement default. MetaPeers is required for readiness (crates/daemon/src/lib.rs:1491-1508) and stored on Configure (1814-1819), but admission uses paired translator credentials (server.rs:262-277) and no runtime read of meta_peers admits a caller. Translator-owned settings are persisted in Nexus Memory and restored over MetaTransport (daemon lib.rs:1522-1528,1833-1859). Needed design: judge each current setting against the complete configuration concept and give MetaPeers a real typed purpose or remove it; do not infer policy from the current fields.
design: Pending Mind beliefNexus Primary judgment. Configuration surface only; configuration subscription has its own bead.
acceptance_criteria: A reviewed table gives every current setting and bootstrap/restore type one owner and witnessed runtime purpose or removes it in the same change. Readiness depends only on fields consumed by the resulting design. Focused tests prove each retained setting changes its named behavior and that no dead required field remains.

title: Repository watching avoids full module snapshots at rest
description: Current evidence: RepositoryPolling is deployed as 100 ms (flake.nix:46); the poll loop snapshots every repository each interval (daemon server.rs:245-259; daemon lib.rs:1877-1909). Snapshot reads main revision, lists the tree, and runs Git show for every module before the daemon compares SourceRevision (emission lib.rs:380-429). Needed design: choose a watch/change-detection boundary whose idle work is bounded without changing the meaning of watching main.
design: Pending Mind beliefNexus Primary judgment. Polling work only; affected-workspace selection and Changed coherence remain belief-nexus-0g7.
acceptance_criteria: An executable probe against a repository with many modules counts external Git invocations across multiple unchanged intervals and proves the approved idle bound. A changed main revision still yields a validated snapshot and the existing downstream change path.

title: Meta configuration changes have a designed subscription
description: Current evidence: meta-signal-belief-nexus 19ef166 has only Configure input and Configured/ConfigureRefused outputs (signal.ethos:5-7); no Subscribe variant exists, while the Nexus vision says a subscription sees configuration as it changes. Needed design: define the configuration-observation contract before implementation, independently of ordinary Belief subscriptions.
design: Pending Mind beliefNexus Primary judgment. This bead owns only configuration observation, not which settings exist.
acceptance_criteria: The approved meta contract names the subscription input, initial state, changed state, terminal behavior, and authority. An executable two-client proof observes an initial coherent revision followed by exactly the configured change, while ordinary Belief subscription behavior is unchanged.

title: Belief launch architecture starts from one Place
description: Current evidence: belief-pair decodes Place plus a hand-written Deployment (crates/translator/src/lib.rs:18-38; bin/belief-pair.rs:104-118), requires Runtime and State directories to pre-exist (112-113), expands two bootstraps (130-150), and replays configuration (158-176). The flake wrapper accepts one Place but hides the second Deployment datom in flake.nix:43-46. Socket names and environment-free daemon/translator bootstraps already match the audit. Needed design: decide the smallest launch architecture that truly starts Belief from its Place, including directory ownership, bootstrap composition, and runtime configuration ownership; do not preserve the hidden Deployment path as compatibility.
design: Pending Mind beliefNexus Primary judgment. This bead owns launch/Place/bootstrap architecture only; XDG State-root correctness has its own bug.
acceptance_criteria: An approved launch contract has Place as the one startup datom and names how executable placement, sockets, Memory, process pairing, and initial configuration are obtained. An executable launch proof starts from that Place, witnesses directory ownership and all four sockets, and observes Ready without a hidden second Deployment datom.

title: Add typed RevisionExhausted configuration refusal in the next Signal version
description: The bounded overflow repair uses existing ConfigurationRefusal::Unavailable because the current wire cannot change. In the next meta Signal version, add a distinct RevisionExhausted refusal so errors remain explicit vocabulary.
acceptance_criteria: The next meta Signal contract declares RevisionExhausted, Belief emits it for i64::MAX configuration revision, translator/CLI round trips it, compatibility/version boundary is explicit, and tests pass.

title: Changed coherently names changed modules and successfully refurnished affected workspaces
description: At immutable belief-nexus 39b422e, every plan records every repository revision, so a move can refurnish unrelated workspaces. Changed is emitted once before refurnish with no workspaces and again per workspace with no modules; retry chooses the first repository in a pending basis. Audit: /home/li/primary/flows/b862a0/audits/belief-nexus-v1-review.md, lines 47-67, 187-199, 301-315, 341-342. This follow-up covers publication coherence, affected-workspace selection, and successful retry notification without unnecessary refurnish. No repair is authorized now.
design: Design is pending the Mind beliefNexus Primary and is judged after first-launch priorities. Model one repository revision change as one candidate snapshot, derive affected workspaces from the modules each workspace actually consumes, publish each affected workspace atomically, and emit the coherent typed result only for successful publications. A recovered retry must retain the originating repository and changed-module basis. Do no repair until the Primary selects the event and partial-failure semantics.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic executable proof furnishes workspace A from a changed module, workspace B from an unchanged module in the same repository, and workspace C from another repository. After the source change, only A receives a new publication. One coherent Changed value names the originating repository, exactly the changed modules, and exactly the successfully refurnished workspaces; no preliminary empty-workspace or per-workspace empty-module Changed is emitted. Forced publication failure omits that workspace from success notification and records typed failure. After restart, a successful retry emits the same originating repository/module basis exactly once. B and C remain byte- and generation-identical. Retention does not grow for unaffected workspaces. Nix checks pass.
